changes.rationale: Fix SLA multiplier formula per RB-201 and RB-203. Original formula incorrectly returned 1 when waiver=Y regardless of ordinary SLA penalties. Correct logic: critical incident without waiver returns 0; all other cases (including waived critical incident) evaluate ordinary SLA conditions (0.6 for both breaches, 0.75 for one breach, 1 otherwise). Evidence: experiment sla_critical_waiver_test showed actual=1 when expected=0.6 for critical incident with waiver=Y and both SLA conditions breached.
